newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian leu 3,268 to dlr for October 11 to 13-BNR.
newsitem.headline: Romanian leu 3,268 to dlr for October 11 to 13-BNR.

text.p: Romania's National Bank (BNR) announced the leu's reference rate weaker at 3,268 to the dollar for October 11 to 13.
This reference rate was set on Wednesday as a weighted average based on daily reports of foreign exchange operators. It is a guidance rate used for statistical accounting purposes.
The leu's reference rate set on Tuesday for October 10 is 3,262 to the dollar, flat from Wednesday's level. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
